blocks.task_summary: Find p and q given the frequency table, mean 31, and variance 124.
method_path: Set up variance equation using formula with sum of squares or sum of squared deviations
Substitute p in terms of q into variance equation
Solve quadratic for q, then find p
accepted_alternatives: Substitute q in terms of p into variance equation and solve for p first.

evidence.basis: M1 for attempt to set up mean or variance; A1 for 8p+4q=380 or p=(95-q)/2; A1 for variance expression; A1 for substitution; M1 for solving; A1 for p=45; A1 for q=5.
